name: Aegis Life-Support Stack
summary: A layered life-support ecosystem of scrubbers, bioreactors, and sealed hydroponics whose tolerances are so tight that maintenance has become a civic ritual.

data.role: Primary atmospheric recycling, water reclamation, and food-loop stabilization for Argonaut Station.

components.name: Atmospheric Scrubber Towers
components.function: CO₂ capture and trace contaminant removal.
components.notes: Designed for redundancy, but sensitive to material compatibility and microfouling.

components.name: Bioreactor Loop
components.function: Biological processing of waste streams into usable feedstocks.
components.notes: Stable when balanced; becomes politically sensitive when inputs are rationed.

components.name: Water Reclamation Spine
components.notes: Failure is gradual and hard to detect without full-spectrum sampling.

components.name: Sealed Hydroponics Vaults
components.notes: Crop schedules are treated like public calendars; disruptions cause social anxiety.

components.name: Thermal Management Lattice
components.function: Heat exchange and condensation control against Titan’s cryogenic exterior.
components.notes: Creates ‘cold memory’ surfaces: frost patterns that maintenance crews learn to read.

principles: Preventive maintenance is cheaper than heroics.
No single sensor is trusted without corroboration.
When the model disagrees with the room, the model wins unless escalation criteria are met.
operational_doctrine.maintenance_culture: Technicians are treated with careful respect; maintenance language leaks into everyday speech.

failure_modes.name: Silent Drift
symptoms: minor air-quality variance within policy tolerances
failure_modes.why_it_is_scary: It looks like normal variance until it isn’t. The first official response is often administrative, not physical.

failure_modes.name: Compatibility Cascade
symptoms: unexpected corrosion or swelling in seals
filter life shortened across multiple bays
failure_modes.why_it_is_scary: A small substitution spreads across the supply chain, and the system begins failing ‘correctly’ according to the wrong assumptions.

failure_modes.name: Quota Breathing
symptoms: public dashboards remain ‘green’ while comfort declines
failure_modes.why_it_is_scary: The colony can survive in the narrowed envelope, but people feel it first. Morale becomes a leading indicator.

signals_and_omens: Soft alarms that rarely escalate, accompanied by a quiet spike in procedural updates.
A rise in ‘temporary’ waivers, each justified, collectively corrosive.
Frost patterns or condensation behavior changing in ways only veteran techs notice.

avoid: instant catastrophic explosions without warning buildup
